names.note: The name as days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 14271 gives it, «Рафаил (Шейченко), иеромонах, исповедник», with the grade and the rank word taken off. Measured with the gate's own fold before it was written: 'рафаил шейченко' has no other holder. The day line prints the bare forename «Рафаила» in the genitive, so the surname is read off the name link; it stays in the parentheses the calendar itself prints. A `grep -rl` for «Шейченко» over the corpus returned nothing.

death.note: The year the day line gives him: «Прп. Рафаила исп (1957).» — where the line's «исп» is printed without its full stop. The name page gives no year of birth and no day within 1957.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 июня ст. ст. — «Прп. Рафаила исп (1957).»

attestations.note: The day's seventh entry of eight, «Прп. Рафаила исп (1957).», the abbreviation «исп» printed without its full stop. Name page 14271 heads him «Рафаил (Шейченко), иеромонах, исповедник» and lists THREE days, «26 января (Новомуч.) , 6 июня , 9 июня (обретение мощеи)» — the third labelled by the source itself as the finding of his relics. **The row is on 6 июня, the day whose page prints him; the 9 июня relics day is not a second feast to record here and the Julian 9 June has not been read yet**, so when it is, this folder wants a `feast.note` and not a moved row. He is исповедник and NOT новомученик: the calendar grades him a confessor and not a martyr, which is why `new-martyr` is not in `types` although the «26 января (Новомуч.)» day stands on his page as it does on every twentieth-century entry's. Иеромонах is `hieromonk` in `types` and the `office` is the bare `Priest` the locale packs carry. There is no /Life/ page for him. The name page links articles on Pravoslavie.Ru — the one it names is by Ксения Орабей, on what he called the most needful ware in life — **and NOT ONE WORD of any of them was read**; the name page prints no teaser of its opening the way Михаил (Вотяков)'s does. So this folder rests on the day line and on the name page's heading and days, and on nothing else. `ls -d saints/raphael*` returned seven folders, all other men, and the day page prints no hymn under his name. azbyka.ru was not read. **The 9 июня day has now been read and this is the note it owed.** Its page prints the relics as the day's seventh and last entry and marks it with no year of his own: «Обретение мощей прп. Рафаила исповедника (2005)», the finding in 2005, forty-eight years after his death; and it grades him прп. there where the 6 июня line grades him прп. too, so the two agree. **That day is one the calendar keeps him on and a second russian row now stands on it.** The 9 июня line names HIM and nobody else — «Обретение мощей прп. Рафаила исповедника (2005)» — and «9 июня (обретение мощей)» stands in his own «Дни памяти» list, which is the calendar’s own statement of which days are his. A translation or finding of relics stays a note where the source does not list it among the man’s days; this one the source does list, and the day page prints a line for it, so it is a row (read 14 October 2026). This row was not moved. The 9 июня page prints no hymn under his name, and name page 14271 was read again and still lists the same three days and still has no /Life/ page. «26 января (Новомуч.)» remains unread (read 8 October 2026).

attestations.note: A SECOND russian row, out of the withheld-second-day backlog of TODO item 19. The folder’s first russian row stands on 6 июня ст. ст., the day of his death, and was not moved, altered or re-sourced. **What this day commemorates is the finding of his relics in 2005, forty-eight years after his death, and the row rests on the calendar listing it among his own days**: name page 14271 heads «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 6 июня , 9 июня (обретение мощей)» and the day page prints the line as its seventh and last entry, naming him and no one else. The grade agrees with the 6 июня line, прп. in both, and the year of the finding is the page’s, not a year of his life, so `dates` are untouched. «26 января (Новомуч.)» remains an unenumerated synaxis and is owed nothing. No hymn is printed under his name on this day (read 14 October 2026).
